newsitem.title: RUSSIA: France's Bic plans Russian razor plant.
newsitem.headline: France's Bic plans Russian razor plant.

text.p: French consumer goods manufacturer Societe Bic plans to open a factory producing disposable razors in Russia in July, the company said on Wednesday.
Philippe Pele-Clamour, managing director of Bic-CIS, said the plant would be based near Moscow, employing around 30 people.
"We're counting on average production of around 40 million units a year. The razors will be of the same quality as those in France," he told Reuters.
"All the machinery will come from Italy and Germany."
Bic is investing about $3 million in the project.

Bic has annual sales for all products (razors, ballpoint pens and lighters) in the Commonwealth of Independent States of around $15-20 million, despite a large number of counterfeit products from China and India, he said.
